title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 20 November 2026
description: Anthropic debuts on the Nasdaq in one of the largest tech listings in years, Australia's unemployment rate jumps to 4.9 per cent, Queensland's National Aquatic Centre nears early works, and the Gold Coast's Graya secures approval for a $160 million beachfront project at Palm Beach. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
